research.title: The Outlook for Retail Stocks as Black Friday Approaches
research.summary: Solid retail sales data and a positive start to retail earnings reporting are demonstrating the strength of the US consumer heading into Black Friday, says Scott Feiler, US consumer sector specialist in Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities. Low jobless claims and declining gas prices also suggest resilient consumer spending, which is showing up in sales for experiences and giving a boost to hotel and cruise-line stocks. At the same time, Feiler says on The Markets podcast that it will be important to monitor how higher material costs flow through to corporate margins and retail prices in 2027.
